record.title: incident retro for the phishing wave from last week
record.summary: The team reviewed the phishing wave incident. The timeline showed a 38-minute gap between the first reported click (09:14) and containment (09:52), with 11 minutes of that delay attributed to Marcus being in a meeting. Marcus identified a process gap regarding escalation routing through a single person. Scope analysis revealed 214 users received the email, 9 clicked, and 3 entered credentials; all three reset credentials within the hour, and no successful logins occurred from attacker infrastructure. Rio noted that the fake ADFS page was live for six hours and highlighted that the finance group still lacks enforced phishing-resistant MFA due to an exemption from the ERP migration, which is no longer necessary as the vendor now supports FIDO keys. Dana assigned Rio to remove the exemption. Priya confirmed that phishing domains were added to the blocklist and takedown requests were sent. Rio suggested adding canary tokens to the login footer to detect clones earlier, and Marcus noted that users lacked acknowledgment for reports, leading to duplicate submissions.
